createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this like was created.

main.description: Record declaring a 'like' of a piece of content published in the Anisota feed. The target of the like is the 'subject' of the record. Most likes are keyed by TID; a like of a spell is keyed 'like' + two FNV-1a hashes of the spell's URI (spellLikeRkey), so one reader can like a given spell only once — hence key 'any'.
